definition: to set something gently in its place
description: At a town square festival at sunset with bunting and balloons, a young woman in a safety harness leans out from a raised metal lift platform and gently lowers one long wooden block onto the very top of a giant stacking-block tower much taller than a person, with sawdust puffing out. She lets go, pulls back her hands and holds on to the railing, staring at the tower. A bald man in the platform watches, and below a large crowd stands tense, many with their hands at their faces.

de.answer: Sie lässt einen Klotz auf den Turm herab.
phrases: sich die Hände vor den Mund halten
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está bajando un bloque sobre la torre.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle descend un bloc sur la tour.
fr.question: Que fait la femme ?
